The '''''Bail Jumper''''' was a modified [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wing starfighter]], painted [[black]] and bronze. The [[Unidentified cyborg pilot|cybernetic pilot]], whose [[Cybernetics/Legends|implants]] negated the need for an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], replaced the standard [[Astromech socket/Legends|astromech socket]] with a fifth fire-linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]].<ref name="TC" />
